name: Out-of-Core SVO Construction via Morton Order
definition: An out-of-core algorithm to build a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) from voxel grid data sorted in Morton order. It reads voxels in groups of 8, generates parent nodes, and flushes buffers to disk to manage memory constraints.
summary: Out-of-core SVO construction via Morton order builds sparse voxel octrees by processing sorted voxel batches and flushing buffers to disk, eliminating top-down parent searches by leveraging full grid space spanning.
